note: Hand-maintained. Role-scoped: the same domain needs different skills for design (architect) vs implementation (developer) vs review (reviewer). Every name in an 'includes' list must exist in .claude/skill-index.json — validated by scripts/validate_skills.py. A cluster's own Tier-1 preloaded skills (this agent's `skills:` frontmatter) are deliberately omitted from 'includes' to avoid a redundant re-load instruction; the routing algorithm dedupes regardless.

standalone_skills.note: Skills intentionally reachable ONLY via .claude/skill-index.json standalone lookup (Tier 3) — no cluster fits them, and they don't need one. Listing a name here suppresses the 'orphaned skill' hard error for it; scripts/validate_skills.py errors if a listed name isn't a real skill, or if it's ALSO covered by some cluster (redundant — remove it from one or the other).

rap-business-object.description: Implementing a RAP business object end-to-end: behavior, actions, validations, determinations, EML, save sequence, the CDS data model underneath it.
load_when: implementing or extending a RAP BO's behavior, actions, validations, or determinations
writing EML to consume or test a RAP BO
implementing the save sequence or numbering for a RAP BO
do_not_load_when: the question is only generic CDS syntax with no RAP behavior involved
the question is only ABAP Unit syntax unrelated to RAP

rap-events-side-effects.description: RAP business events and Fiori-refresh side effects.
load_when: the RAP BO raises or consumes business events, or needs Fiori-refresh side effects

rap-fiori-ui.description: The Fiori UI layer on top of a RAP BO: @UI annotations, metadata extensions, facets, value helps.
load_when: the task includes @UI annotations, metadata extensions, facets, or value helps for the BO

cds-data-model.description: A CDS data model task with no RAP behavior involved: views, VDM layering, annotations, entity types.
load_when: writing or modifying a CDS view, association, or annotation with no RAP behavior in scope
designing custom/abstract CDS entity types, table functions, or hierarchies
do_not_load_when: the task is really a RAP BO — use rap-business-object instead, it already includes the CDS skills
the task also needs Fiori UI annotations — add cluster rap-fiori-ui on top, don't expect this cluster to cover it

classic-modernization.description: Converting legacy procedural or classic-UI ABAP toward modern OO/RAP constructs.
load_when: converting FORM/PERFORM or a MACRO to a method
converting a classic ALV/dynpro report toward OO or RAP+Fiori

oo-core.description: Core OO design and data-handling questions not specific to RAP/CDS: classes, patterns, data objects, constructor expressions, internal tables.
load_when: designing or refactoring classes, interfaces, or exception hierarchies
choosing a constructor expression (VALUE/CORRESPONDING/REDUCE/FILTER/COND/SWITCH) or an internal-table kind/key

sql-hana-performance.description: Database and HANA-pushdown performance work beyond core Open SQL (already Tier-1 preloaded for this role).
load_when: pushing logic down to HANA via AMDP/SQLScript
internal-table access pattern is part of a performance investigation
table buffering, key, or DDIC design is implicated in the slowdown
reasoning about COMMIT/ROLLBACK WORK, ENQUEUE/DEQUEUE, or SAP LUW boundaries
scheduling background jobs or fanning work out in parallel

service-integration.description: Exposing or consuming external services: OData, XML/JSON payloads.
load_when: exposing or consuming an OData service
serializing/parsing XML or JSON
generating a form, print output, or PDF

repository-tooling.description: Generating repository objects from code and version control.
load_when: generating a repository object via XCO
working with abapGit repositories

debugging.description: Root-causing a dump, trace, or runtime error before fixing it.
load_when: diagnosing an ST22 dump, ST05/SAT trace, or an unexplained runtime error

rap-business-object.description: Designing a RAP business object's shape, save strategy, and authorization model (rap-bo-modeling and cds-views-authoring are already Tier-1 preloaded for this role).
load_when: choosing managed/unmanaged/abstract RAP, draft, or the behavior contract shape
deciding the save sequence or numbering strategy
designing the authorization model for the BO

rap-business-object-cloud.description: Addition to the RAP business object cluster when the target is ABAP Cloud / Steampunk.
load_when: the RAP BO targets ABAP Cloud / Steampunk and released-API compatibility is a design constraint

cds-data-model.description: Designing a CDS data model's layering, keys, and access control (cds-views-authoring is already Tier-1 preloaded for this role).
load_when: deciding CDS VDM layering, associations, or entity-type choice
designing keys, buffering strategy, or the authorization model for the model

extend-standard.description: Deciding how to extend standard SAP without modifying it.
load_when: choosing between a BAdI, an implicit enhancement, or a RAP BO extension

modernization-strategy.description: Deciding whether and how to modernize legacy ABAP toward OO, CDS, or ABAP Cloud.
load_when: recommending FORM->method, DB SELECT->CDS, or ALV->RAP+Fiori
recommending a classic-to-cloud migration path

service-architecture.description: Architecture for OData exposure and service activation.
load_when: designing OData exposure or service activation strategy

async-architecture.description: Architecture for asynchronous or parallel-fan-out execution.
load_when: designing background-job, async, or parallel-fan-out architecture

transaction-architecture.description: Architecture for SAP LUW / transactional boundaries.
load_when: designing SAP LUW / transactional boundaries or locking strategy

rap-bo-cds.description: Reviewing a RAP BO or CDS view for authorization, injection, exposure, and OO smells (abap-code-review, abap-clean-style, abap-sql-performance are already Tier-1 preloaded for this role).
load_when: the artifact under review is a RAP BO or CDS view/projection

oo-classes.description: Reviewing OO classes and constructor-expression usage for design smells.
load_when: the artifact under review is primarily class/interface design or constructor-expression usage

classic-procedural.description: Reviewing a classic report or procedural ABAP for modernization and OO opportunities.
load_when: the artifact under review is a classic report, FORM/PERFORM, or procedural code

sql-hana-performance.description: Reviewing performance-critical SQL/HANA code beyond core Open SQL (already Tier-1 preloaded for this role).
load_when: the artifact under review pushes logic to HANA (AMDP/SQLScript/table functions) or performance is the primary review lens

security-sensitive.description: Reviewing auth, dynamic code, or released-API exposure as the primary security lens.
load_when: the review scope is explicitly security: authorization, dynamic SQL/ASSIGN, released-API exposure
